items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Earl Warren was his lawyer during all this...inventions

ctx.x: Earl Warren! Earl Warren was his lawyer during all this...inventions, before he got to be governor. Yeah. Yeah, Earl Warren. Ehhh, small world, isn't it? Now, he's got a lot of stuff. This is not...this is just stuff that I happened to know...to find that he...uh, that I didn't give his son, you know, and he had a lot of

inventions that he had patented. Some of 'em he never did do no good with, you know. But he just was full of that stuff, and my brother Johnny was likewise because he never did pay no attention to it. He stuck with music. He had all kinds of ideas--like that Musical Meat Market and things--that was all his ideas, you know, and...
